text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} needs some clothes mended,
so he makes his way to Tsumugi's store.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}は破れた服を補修してもらうために
ツムギの店へ向かった。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: *sigh*...
text_block_list.orig_text: はぁ……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Welcome to Tsumugi's Apparel!
text_block_list.orig_text: いらっしゃいませー！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Oh. It's you, Mr. Knight. What do you want?
If you're here to taunt me, don't bother.
choice_data_list: I tore these clothes during a job...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだ騎士さんですか。
何しに来たんです？
冷やかしなら帰ってくださいね。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
A-all right, all right!
You don't have to shove them right in my face!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
分かりましたから！
そんなに近づかないでください！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Let me have a look.
...Oh, I can fix this up in no time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ちょっと見せてください。
こんなのすぐに繕えますよ。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I'd rather not deal with you ever again,
but I do feel sorry for your clothes. Go on, hand them over.
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当ならもう一切関わりたくありませんけど、
服に罪はありませんし。
さっさとこっちに貸してください。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Uerghh... What have you done to this thing? It's frayed and torn all over.
Hold on a minute.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわっ……
なんですかこれ。
あちこちボロボロじゃないですか。
ちょっと待っててください。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
There. That should do it.
Try to be more careful with this in the future.
No need for payment—just promise me you'll take care of your clothing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
出来ましたよ。
これ以上傷めないでくださいね。
お代はいいですから、
服は大事に着てあげてください。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
You've got a another job now?
Wh-why should I give a flying flip about your work?
It's none of my business!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これからまた仕事？
べ、
別にあなたがどこで何の仕事をしようが、
知ったこっちゃありませんよ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Come on, hurry and get out of my sight! Shoo, shoo!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
さっさとどっか行ってください！　
しっしっ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Arghhh, he seriously drives me crazy!
What does Rei see in a guy like that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あーもうムカつく！
なんでレイ様はあんな人と……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
When Rei dropped by the other day, she was practically glowing.
I'd never seen her like that before.
How does Mr. Knight manage to have that effect on her?
text_block_list.orig_text:
この間のレイ様……
あんなに明るい表情、
初めて見た。
……なんで騎士さんは、
レイ様とあんなに……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about it is just making me more annoyed!
I wish he'd mess up his job and wind up the laughingstock of the town!
text_block_list.orig_text:
考えてたらもぉ～っとムカついてきた！
仕事で大失敗して、
悪い噂でも広まればいいのに……！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, that's it!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──それだ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I'll set him up for an embarrassing failure,
and when word gets around, Rei will lose her trust in him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕事を失敗するように仕向けて、
その話が広まれば、
レイ様からも信頼されなくなるはず……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Talk about a foolproof plan!
All right, work's over for today! Let's put this plan into action!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……我ながら、完っ璧な計画！
今日はもう店じまい！　
早速実行するぞぉー！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Now, where did Mr. Knight go... There he is!
I'd better get ahead of him before he leaves the city!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士さんはどこに……
いた！　
あっちが街から出る前に、
なんとしても先回りしなきゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Past the gates, it's a straight path across the plains...I've gotta set something up before he arrives!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この先は平原に続く一本道……
先回りして仕掛けないと！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
This spot should do nicely.
Now then... Let's make this the perfect trap!
I'll set a trip wire with this translucent thread I wove from monster fur...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ここがいいかな。
さてと……
最高の罠を仕掛けるぞぉー！
まずはこの魔物の毛で編んだ、
半透明の糸で転ばせてっと……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: There. All ready!There's no way he'll see this one coming!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──よし。出来た！　
これなら騎士さんには気づかれないはず！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Now to watch and wait!
I'll keep that nasty parasite away from my Rei!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあかかって来なさい！
レイ様に近づく虫は全て私が始末します！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Tsumugi waits by her perfect trap for over an hour,
but {0} is nowhere to be seen.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──その後ツムギは一時間以上待ち続けたが、
{0}は一向に現れなかった。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Where is he? He should definitely be here by now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……来ない。
絶対ここを通るはずなのに……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Could something have happened to him?
A monster attack, maybe?! ...Wait, why am I worrying about him?
Anyway, I should investigate!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして騎士さんに何かあった……？　
魔物に襲われたとか！？
……いやいや心配してどうする。
とにかく偵察しに行かなきゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
There he is! Why's he all the way back here?
Did he pass out while standing up, or what?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いた！　
まだあんなとこに……
立ったまま気絶でもしてるんじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Thank you kindly, young man.
I hope my bags aren't too heavy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうね、
お兄さん。
荷物、
重くないかい？

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry I can't offer you anything in return...
I really do appreciate it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
何のお礼も出来ないのに、
すまないねぇ……
本当にありがとう……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Who's he trying to fool with the good-guy act?!
He's just some dirty creep with his eyes on Rei...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにさ、いい人ぶって！
レイ様に近づく悪い虫のくせに……！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
No. I know that's not true. I'm sure he really is a good guy.
And to think I was plotting to ruin his life...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……違う。
そんなことない。
騎士さんは本当にいい人なんだ。
そんな人に私、
なんてことを……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I guess... I'll clear away this trap.
text_block_list.orig_text:
罠……
片付けよう。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Aw, man...
What possessed me to come up with such a stupid idea?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーあ……
私、
なんでこんなバカなこと考えついたんだろ……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Aaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Owwww... What's the big idea?!
Who dug a pitfall trap in a place like this?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いたたた……
誰なんですか！
こんな所に落とし穴なんて掘ったの！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
...It was me, of course.
And then I fell into my own trap like an idiot...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私だ。
自分で罠に引っかかるなんて……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Well, do I [i]look[/i] like I'm OK?!
Whose fault do you think it is I ended up in this mess?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これが大丈夫そうに見えます！？
誰のせいでこうなったと思ってるんですかぁ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Don't look at me with that genuinely worried face!
If it weren't for you, none of this would have happened!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな心配そうな顔してこっち見ないでください！
こうなったのはそもそも……！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
You just had to help that little old lady!
And now I'm stuck at the bottom of my own stupid pitfall!
choice_data_list: Why did you dig a pitfall?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士さんがおばあさんを助けちゃうから！
おかげで仕掛けた罠に自分でかかったんですよ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Because I... Because I didn't want to see you
getting any closer to my Rei!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは……
騎士さんとレイ様がこれ以上、
親しくなって欲しくないからです……！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: That's the only reason! So leave me alone, why don't you?!
choice_data_list: Help Tsumugi out of the pit.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それだけですから！　
私のことは放っておいてください！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Weren't you listening to a word I said...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
助けなくていいって、
言ったのに……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Look at me, getting saved by the guy I was trying to sabotage...
It's so pathetic, I want to curl up and die...
text_block_list.orig_text:
罠にはめようとしていた相手から助けられるなんて……
情けなくて死にたいです……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Um...! Thank you... very much.
And, um, I'm sorry for trying to set a trap for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あの！　
ありがとうございます。
あと、
罠にかけようとして……
すみませんでした。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: But I'm still not letting you have Rei, you got that?!
text_block_list.orig_text: でもレイ様は騎士さんなんかに渡しませんからねっ！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: I wasn't aware I was your property to give away, Tsumugi.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……私がツムギの物になっていたとは知らなかったよ。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: R-Rei?! Wh-why are you...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
レイ様！？　
ど、
どうして！？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
I came to check on our friend here, since he wasn't showing up.
And where should I find him but peering into a pit
in the middle of the road?
text_block_list.orig_text:
彼がいつまでも仕事に来ないから、
心配で迎えに来たんだ。
すると
道の真ん中に空いた穴を覗いていたというわけさ。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
You were heading to a job with Rei...?
Why didn't you mention that in the first place?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
レイ様と一緒の仕事だなんて……！
そんなの聞いてませんよ騎士さん……！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
I hope you're ready to give a proper explanation
for how all this happened?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしてこんなことになっているのか、
説明してもらえるよね？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. The truth is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はい。
それは──

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: ...And that's how I wound up in this pit.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……以上です。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... This young man isn't the scoundrel you imagine.
You realize that now, right? Why did you go to such lengths?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
彼はツムギが考えていたような下劣な人間じゃない。
それはもう分かっただろう？
　どうしてこんな真似をしたんだ？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't bear to see you and him together, that's all!
When you're with him... you smile like I've never seen you smile before!
text_block_list.orig_text:
レイ様が騎士さんにだけ優しくするのが嫌だったんですー！
だってレイ様、
騎士さんにはすっごくいい笑顔見せるじゃないですか！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Wha...?! I-I don't know what you mean!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ！
　べ、
別に私は……！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Now you're even blushing over him! I can't take any of this!
It's not fair at all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度は照れ顔まで……！　
ますます許せません！
騎士さんばっかりズルいです！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ――グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: A monster?! Why's there a monster around here?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物！？　
なんでこんなとこに！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
That's what we were sent to do today—
take care of a nasty monster sighted in these parts.
So this works out nicely. Back us up, Tsumugi!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この先の平野に出た魔物退治が
今日の私たちの仕事なんだ。
ちょうどいい、
ツムギも手伝って！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I'm fighting too?! B-but what should I do?
choice_data_list: Let's set a trap for the monster.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私もですか！？　
で、
でも何をしたら……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Knight... Are you serious?
I'm not sure if I can...
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士さん、
それ本気ですか？
出来るかな……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
That's a fine idea. The two of us will lure the monster to this spot,
so you set up the trap, Tsumugi! All right, let's move!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いい考えだ。
私と彼でここまでおびき寄せるから、
ツムギは罠の準備を頼む！
　
キミ、
行くよ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Ahh! But, Rei...! Mr. Knight...!
...They both trust me, even after what I did...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
レイ様！　
騎士さん！
……二人とも、
あんなことをした私を信じてる……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Honestly! You're both far too purehearted!
Fine, I'll do it! You just wait and see!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう！　
どっちもお人好しなんだから！
やりますよ！　
やってやりますよ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRUOOOGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Tsumugi! Is the trap ready?
{0}, power me up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ツムギ！
　準備はいい？
キミは私を強化して！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Everything's ready here! Take a couple more steps backward,
and then jump! Now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
準備出来ました！　
あと少し後ろに下がったら
飛び退いてください！　
……今です！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Right, here goes! Hahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
後ろに跳ぶよ！
　はっ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Come on... This has to work!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お願い、
上手くいって！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GGRRAAAAAOOOGGHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: All riiight! Rei, I'll let you do the honors!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったぁ！　
レイ様、後はお願いします！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Very well!
I'll end this in an instant! Hurricane Slash!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ！
一気に切り刻む！
　スラッシュストーム！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GGRRAAAAAOOOGGHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Whew. That's the end of that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふぅ。
終わったね。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! You're amazing, Rei!
And Mr. Knight, what was that weird magic you just used?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい……！　
すごいですレイ様！
騎士さんもなんですかさっきの魔法みたいな技！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
That's a special ability he possesses.
You did well too, Tsumugi.
Now, could you carry the monster back to town?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれは彼が持つ特別な力だよ。
ツムギも良くやったね。
次は魔物を街まで運んでもらおうか。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
This heavy monster? On my own?
Y-you're so funny, Rei! What a joker you can be sometimes...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……これを一人で、
ですか？
や、
やだなぁレイ様。
冗談もお上手なんですね……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
I mean it. You need to make up for what you tried to do.
Now, hurry up, or it'll be dark before you reach the city.
text_block_list.orig_text:
本気さ。
彼を陥れようとした罰は受けてもらう。
早くしないと、
街へ着く前に日が暮れるよ。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay! Please forgive me, Rei!
I'm sorry, Mr. Knight! I'll never do it agaaaain!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなぁ～！　
許してくださいレイ様～！
騎士さんごめんなさ～い！　
もう二度としませんから～！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Tsumugi's eyes fill with tears of desperation,
{0} too asked Rei to let her off the hook.
text_block_list.orig_text:
目の端に涙を浮かべてすがりつくツムギの様子に、
{0}は許してあげようとレイに呼びかけた。
